notes.title: Ver1.01 update
notes.content: [p]Hello, thank you for playing "SANAE's Sylphid Breeze".[/p][p]Today, we released the Ver.1.01 update with the following changes.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay Improvements[/b] [/h3][list][*][p][b]Visualization of Uncollected Spell Shrines per Level[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]After clearing HARD Mode: Gates will now show icons indicating any uncollected spell shrines per level[/p][list][*][p][b]Visualization of Clear Indicator for Boss Defeat Without Using Spells[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]After clearing HARD Mode: Gates will now display flags if bosses were defeated without using spells[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other Improvement[/b][/p][list][*][p]Shorter frame after shooting airballet[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Added recovery handling for rare softlock when hit by an upward knockback attack[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Added recovery handling for rare softlock when hit by an attack that has wall-collision properties[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Added recovery handling for bug when entering off-screen areas (e.g. during Kanako’s appearance)[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]→ In these cases, the player is now forcibly returned to the play area.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Fix a bug with Fist Sign charge behavior[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Players were previously able to jump during a charge, causing the attack to become unusable mid-air.[/p][p]Now, jumping is disabled while charging to preserve intended mechanics.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fix an occasional crash during fighting with Iku Nagae in Level 4 HARD[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Correct an unintended encounter with Suika Ibuki from the wrong position in Level 4[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix missing fall detection in a spot in Level 2:Giant Frog Pond[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Prevent Marisa Kirisame from healing her HP above the maximum value in EXTRA[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Block access to areas in the Tengu Rumei race that shouldn’t be enterable[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix a bug in the Tengu Rumei race where each finish overwrites your best time with the latest result, even if it isn’t a new record[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix an issue where the laser charge sound continued after defeating Nitori Kawashiro[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ensure voice-volume settings no longer reset unexpectedly[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We hope these improvements enhance your gameplay experience.[/p][p]Thank you again for your support![/p]

notes.title: "SANAE's Sylphid Breeze" DEMO Now Available!
notes.content:
I've released a demo for "SANAE's Sylphid Breeze", and I've also joined Steam Next Fest (Feb 24-Mar 3)!

Note:
- The demo save data cannnot be carried over to the full game.
- The demo will only be available until 31 march.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3520050/SANAEs_Sylphid_Breeze_Demo/

The demo version consists of demo-only stages that re-organize some stages from the full version.
You can try five spells from them.

[list]
[*][b]Hina Kagiyama[/b] : Misfortune Sign "[b]Red Relief[/b]"
[*][b]Chen[/b] : Sikigami Sign "[b]Orange Overwrit[/b]e"
[*][b]Nitori Kawashiro[/b] : River Sign "[b]Green Generator[/b]"
[*][b]Cirno[/b] : Ice Sign "[b]Blue Blizzard[/b]"
[*][b]Kogasa Tatara[/b] : Umbrella Sign "[b]Violet Vortex[/b]"
[/list]

And more, you can battle against [b]Marisa[/b] and [b]Nitori[/b] !!

Then, if you clear this DEMO, you can try the mini-game"TENGU-RUMEI-RACE".

"SANAE's Sylphid Breeze" is under development, with a release date of spring 2025.
If you like it, please register on our Wishlist and wait for further news!
